mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVATT20070.retrieveAttContractOrg */ ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID AS CODE ,ORG_M.ORG_NAME_LOCAL AS NAME FROM TB_ATT_CONTRACT_N ATT LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG_MASTER ORG_M ON (ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID = ORG_M.ORGANIZATION_ID) WHERE ATT.TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID=#{employeeNo} AND att.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN nvl(att.effective_start_date, to_date('0001-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND NVL(att.effective_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND SYSDATE BETWEEN nvl(ORG_M.org_start_date, to_date('0001-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND NVL(ORG_M.org_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) ORDER BY ORG_M.ORG_NAME_LOCAL

SELECT /* LGVATT20070.retrieveAttContractOrgLineWorkerList */ ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID ,M.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER AS CODE ,M.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER AS NAME FROM TB_ATT_CONTRACT_N ATT LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_MASTER M ON (ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID = M.ORGANIZATION_ID) WHERE ATT.TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID=#{employeeNo} AND att.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN nvl(att.effective_start_date, to_date('0001-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND NVL(att.effective_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND M.Status = 'Active Assignment' AND M.flsa_yn = 'N' AND M.fse_yn = 'N'
SELECT /* LGVATT20070."retrieveEmployeeName" */ M.FULL_NAME_LOCAL AS EMPLOYEE_NAME FROM EMP_MASTER M WHERE M.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER=#{employeeNo}

SELECT EM.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID ,EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER CODE ,EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER NAME ,lgvatt_common_pkg.get_unit_requestor( #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} ,#{orgId} ) AS org_get_arm_info FROM EMP_MASTER EM WHERE EM.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{orgId} AND EM.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND EM.Status = 'Active Assignment' AND EM.flsa_yn = 'N' AND EM.fse_yn = 'N' ORDER BY EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER

select /* LGVATT20070.retrieveShftTypeAndNightFlag */ tar.shift_type_code ,tar.night_shift_flag ,(SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_SHIFT_TYPE_CODE', tar.shift_type_code, NULL, 'en') AS FROM dual) AS shift_type_name ,(SELECT lgvatt_common_pkg.get_holiday_flag(tar.subsidiary_code, tar.shift_type_code, tar.time_and_attendance_date) FROM DUAL) AS holiday_flag /* 휴일여부 */ ,lgvatt_common_pkg.get_att_code_info(tar.subsidiary_code, tar.time_and_attendance_code, 'NAME') AS attendance_name ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(tar.subsidiary_code, tar.employee_no, tar.time_and_attendance_date, tar.time_and_attendance_date, 'month_total_ot_yyyymm') AS month_total_overtime ,lgvatt_ot_level_pkg.get_ot_level(tar.subsidiary_code, tar.employee_no, tar.time_and_attendance_yyyymm, 'request_lower_limit') as overtime_limit from tb_att_result_n tar where 1 = 1 and tar.subsidiary_code = 'LGDVN' and tar.employee_no = #{employeeNo} and tar.time_and_attendance_date = to_date(#{attendanceDate},'DD/MM/YYYY')

SELECT /* LGVATT20070.retrieveRequestDocBaseInfo */ cc.code_data1_value AS arm_no , cc.parent_common_code AS request_code /* LGCOM 결재의 문서유형코드LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_CODE와 매핑 */ FROM lgcom_common_code_c cc WHERE cc.code_type_code = 'LGVCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_CODE' AND cc.common_code = 'ATT0005' /* 사무직 수정요청서 결재요청 */

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dup_count FROM tb_att_special_ot_result_n ta WHERE 1 = 1 AND ta.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} AND ta.time_and_attendance_date = TO_DATE(#{attendanceDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND ta.progress_status_code IN ('20', '30', '40') --기등록 건( 50: Cancel 제외) AND NVL(ta.confirm_flag, 'N') <> 'R' -- Rejected AND ta.employee_no = #{employeeNo}
